title: Your Travel Just Got More Rewarding: Air India and IHG Join Hands
description: Air India and IHG Hotels & Resorts have partnered to make your travel more rewarding. If you're an Air India Maharaja Club member, you can now earn Maharaja P.

faq.q: What are Maharaja Club and IHG One Rewards?
faq.a: Maharaja Club is the frequent flyer program for Air India, rewarding customers for flying with the airline. IHG One Rewards is the loyalty program for IHG Hotels & Resorts, offering benefits and points for stays at their various hotel brands globally.

faq.q: Do I need to do anything special to earn points?
faq.a: Yes, if you are a Maharaja Club member, you will likely need to select Air India Maharaja Club as your earning preference when booking or checking into an IHG hotel. For the 3x points promotion, you must register for it.

faq.q: Can I earn points at all IHG brands?
faq.a: You can earn Maharaja Points at most IHG Hotels & Resorts worldwide. The earning rate might vary slightly for certain brands, like Candlewood Suites or Staybridge Suites.

faq.q: Is there a minimum number of IHG points I need to convert?
faq.a: Yes, you need a minimum of 1,000 IHG One Rewards Points to convert them into Air India Maharaja Points.

faq.q: How long will this partnership last?
faq.a: The announcement does not specify an end date for the overall partnership, suggesting it is a long-term collaboration. The special 3x points offer is valid until December 31, 2026.
